#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int h, n;
    std::cin >> h >> n;
    int n_minus_one = n - 1;
    std::string N = "";
    while (n_minus_one > 0) {
        N = (n_minus_one % 2 == 0 ? "0" : "1") + N;
        n_minus_one /= 2;
    }
    // Pad with leading zeros to length h
    N = std::string(h - N.length(), '0') + N;

    int total_moves = 0;
    bool flip_flag = false;
    for (int index = 0; index < h; ++index) {
        char expected_char = flip_flag ? '0' : '1';
        if (N[index] != expected_char) {
            flip_flag = !flip_flag;
            total_moves += 1;
        } else {
            total_moves += (int)pow(2, h - index);
        }
    }
    std::cout << total_moves << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
